name: Host To ATM Request V 01
definition: The HostToATMRequest message is sent by a host to an ATM to request the ATM to contact a host by sending of a maintenance messages.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

HostToATMRequest.name: Host To ATM Request
HostToATMRequest.definition: Information related to the request to an ATM to contact the ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
